requirements.text: The FIFO shall accept a write when wr_en is asserted and full is deasserted.
The FIFO shall present valid read data when rd_en is asserted and empty is deasserted.
On reset the FIFO must clear its occupancy so that empty is asserted and full is deasserted.
A write when full or a read when empty is an illegal operation and must be flagged as an error.
The FIFO shall sustain back-to-back writes at one word per cycle at the target throughput.
The FIFO is easy to use.
